# Contacts Cleaner

> Contacts Cleaner is a mobile app and companion website for cleaning up phone contacts on iPhone and Android, including duplicate detection, junk cleanup, formatting fixes, WhatsApp-related cleanup guidance, and support/legal information.

This file is a curated guide for LLMs and agents. Prefer the markdown resources below over raw HTML when a concise site overview is sufficient. For a longer single-file context, use `llms-full.txt`.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://contactscleaner.tech/): Main marketing page for Contacts Cleaner, including app overview, positioning, and structured data.
- [Full site context](https://contactscleaner.tech/llms-full.txt): Expanded product, policy, support, and blog context in one markdown-friendly file.
